Requires E28 Android 9, local ADB authorization and shell access to vendor services. Select the navigation card on the instrument. No Root, location or notification-reading permission is required.
Optional. On release, restore a current cached state or wait for the next factory update.
Queries NetEase Music first, then LRCLIB. Sends song title, artist, album and duration. Requires internet on the head unit; cached lyrics work offline.

Compensates for CarPlay audio latency by delaying lyrics for all songs. Range: 0–5000 ms, step: 50 ms. Applies immediately without reconnecting.
Uses the independent iPhone map stream. Enabling takes effect at the next connection; choose when to reconnect. Stop other instrument senders first.
Waiting for the iPhone independent map; reconnect if map was enabled during this session
Shows synchronized lyrics while playing; otherwise shows the song title and lookup status. No overlay permission needed. Uses the shared global lyric delay.
Hold the lyric panel, then drag. Ordinary taps and swipes pass through to CarPlay. Turn off to drag immediately.
The next line moves up and becomes the current line in 250 ms. Applies immediately; seeking, changing songs and dragging refresh directly.
Configure CarPlay floating lyrics, font size, transitions, position, sources, cache and delay.
Configure the instrument map, authorization, automatic start, status and restoration.
